description: Look up the publisher of an API and return their positive-only trust badges: Established (>=3 months tenure), Top contributor (>=1M lifetime successful calls), Highly rated (>=4.5 avg across >=10 reviews). New publishers come back unmarked — absence of badges is NOT a warning, just a lack of accumulated signal. Use this BEFORE calling an unfamiliar API to gauge counterparty risk.
name: gatefare.publisher_reputation
